test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sheet is folded to form a cube. In the cube so formed, select the letter which will be on the opposite of face representing the letter 'D'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae339cf4ab9a161722fd721d12dcf5059dc1cf3639de7b03e683fdf75e2bec3e.png]
solution:
The paper when folded to form a dice, the faces that will be opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48095bb1ecc5b9a86743738dbc5f644302d26124a0c2ea5218bd8ec6c2871c0a.png] 

Clearly, B will be the face opposite to D.

Hence, '**B**' is the correct answer.
